description: This file defines a PHP class 'CopyActivityModel' used in the orangehrmTimePlugin for managing and transforming activity data related to projects, specifically for copying activities between projects within the HRM system. It implements serialization and construction interfaces and uses traits for project services.

classes.name: CopyActivityModel
classes.description: A model representing activities that can be copied within the HRM system, capable of serializing its data into an array format.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with project activities from the source project and the duplicated activities.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model data to an array, marking activities as unique or duplicated.
